players.bio: Adetokunbo Bamidele Adeyemo (born 13 July 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Crawley Town as a forward.

Akinwale Joseph Odimayo (born 28 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crawley Town. Odimayo began his career with Reading, turning professional in July 2018, and making his senior debut for the club on 27 August 2019 in the EFL Cup.
Charlie Mel Barker (born 12 February 2003) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crawley Town.

Colin Kazım-Richards (born 26 August 1986), also known as Colin Kâzım, Kâzım or Kâzım Kâzım, is a professional football coach and former player who played as a forward. He is the head coach of EFL League Two club Crawley Town. Born in England, Kazim-Richards represented the Turkey national team. Born and raised in England, he qualified for Turkish nationality through his mother's heritage.

Danilo Harley Orsi-Dadomo (born 19 April 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Crawley Town. He has also played for Harrogate Town, Grimsby Town, Burton Albion and AFC Wimbledon.
Dion Enrico Pereira Greives (born 25 March 1999) is a footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two side Crawley Town. Born in England, he plays for the Antigua and Barbuda national team.

Dylan James Morgan (born 20 September 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or forward for EFL League Two club Crawley Town. He has previously played in non-league with Taunton Town, Yeovil Town, Weston-super-Mare and Torquay United.
Gianmarco Di Biase (born 26 November 2005) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Crawley Town.
Jackson Izquierdo is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Crawley Town F.C. in EFL League Two.

Jonathan Edward Russell (born 19 September 2004) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crawley Town, and the Northern Ireland national under-21 team.
Jude Robert Arthurs (born 6 August 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crawley Town.
Justin Ferizaj (born 13 January 2005) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Crawley Town.
Kai Edward Jennings (born 18 February 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Crawley Town, on loan from EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.
Kellan Gordon (born 25 December 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a wing-back for Crawley Town.
Klaudio Krasniqi (born 26 December 2000) is an English association footballer of Albanian descent who plays as a defensive midfielder for Crawley Town.
Lewis Paul Jimmy Richards (born 15 October 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Crawley Town. Born in England, he represented Ireland at youth level.
Louie Shaun Watson (born 7 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Crawley Town.
Malcolm Perewari Ebiowei (born 4 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for EFL League Two club Crawley Town.

Nathan Tinsdale is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Crawley Town F.C., on loan from Hull City A.F.C.. Born in December 2004, the 21-year-old developer came through the youth ranks at Bradford City before joining the Hull City academy in July 2023.
Nicolas Michal Michalski (born 14 March 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Crawley Town, on loan from Blackburn Rovers.

Osman Kamara is a 20-year-old professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for EFL League Two club Crawley Town, on loan from Blackburn Rovers. Born in London, he represents Sierra Leone at the international youth level.
Pele Arganese-McDermott is a 20-year-old professional football player who plays as a central defender for League Two side Crawley Town.

Oluwalopemiwa Adedunmola Aderoju (born 5 May 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Crawley Town on loan from EFL League One club Peterborough United.

Priestley Tyler Heginbottom Farquharson (born 15 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Crawley Town. He has been capped by the England national beach soccer team.
Stephen Winston Duke-McKenna is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two side Crawley Town. Born in England, he plays for the Guyana national team.

Ty Ewens-Findlay is a 19-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a versatile defender for Crawley Town F.C.. He is currently on a season-long loan from his parent club, Charlton Athletic F.C..

Vito Mannone (born 2 March 1988) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. He has represented Italy at U21 level. Previously Mannone played for Arsenal, Barnsley, Hull City, Sunderland, Reading, Minnesota United and Esbjerg fB.
